scope: Complete source-faithful subsection translation; not a claim of complete assignment, curriculum certification, or human validation.

consultations.decision: Read the canon workflow and bank, the terminology ledger, and the existing OCR. Checked Tripura images rather than accepting garbled OCR fractions. TR01 and p50 support লব, হর, প্রকৃত ভগ্নাংশ, অপ্রকৃত ভগ্নাংশ and a mixed fraction as the sum of a whole number and proper fraction. The existing p52 exercise 4 is a targeted supplement: it asks for 2/3 on a number line and supports সংখ্যারেখায় অবস্থান দেখাও. It is not a worked example of negative fractions.

Rechecked fraction names and learner-facing imperative register while translating position instructions. Kept the project's মিশ্র সংখ্যা term while recording witnessed মিশ্র ভগ্নাংশ as a synonym. Used পূর্ণ in spoken mixed-number descriptions; explicitly described a negative mixed number as the opposite of the whole positive mixed number. Source-image inspection exposed English alt count errors; Bengali alt now describes actual equal subdivisions and adds visible whole-number markers omitted from English alt. MathML, source images and source hierarchy are not edited.

Reread the relevant OCR against the already inspected p50/p52 images, then read all 31 assembled Bengali prose nodes with the unchanged MathML punctuation. Recast phrases before embedded sentence stops so Bengali postpositions do not follow an English full stop. Used the common nodes XPath slots schema for the ID-less m81275 link. Inspected all remaining source images; figure 061 retains two prior mixed-number markers omitted by English alt, now explicitly described. Figure 044's full 0–6 scale is described. Thirteen rational checks confirm conversions and opposite-number interpretations. No Bengali human or screen-reader certification is claimed.

coverage_limits: The local canon supplies Indian Bengali fraction terms and a number-line instruction, but no reviewed worked negative-fraction or negative-mixed-number number-line example. Negative-number wording is editorial and requires independent West Bengal teacher/language review.
Tripura witnesses are supplementary Indian Bengali references, not West Bengal curriculum certification.
The p52 exercise asking for a proper fraction with numerator 9 and denominator 7 is mathematically inconsistent; it was not used. Only exercise 4 supplies the number-line wording.
The existing manipulative activity reference is translated, not evidence that the external activity itself has been translated or made available offline.
Original image pixels are retained. Figures 055 and 057 contain embedded English unit labels; Bengali alt supplies their meaning, but the images are not fully localized graphics.
